summary.t: The mask across the eyes, the striped tail.

text.t:
A dark mask around the eyes and a striped tail, both painted by hand. It sits with its paws together and its belly full of light.

A piece with plenty of character, for children who have started choosing what goes on their own walls.

options.power.help.t: Batteries are not included. The mains version comes with a remote: on, off, dimmer, timer and a slow pulse.

options.engraving.help.t: A name, a date or a short phrase, burned into the wood. Leave it empty if you would rather not.
